sources.title: Corinna Hill — RIT Directory
sources.author: Rochester Institute of Technology
sources.content: Corinna Hill studies Deaf and disability history, language access, medicine, technology, and social relationships, including oral histories of Deaf clubs and Deaf/hearing friendships.

sources.content: Oral-history practice requires preparation, informed participation, accurate descriptive information, careful preservation, and context that helps future audiences interpret the recorded interview.
